column1: # RHDH RBAC Policy — Platform Template Governance
# This file is mounted into RHDH via the Backstage CR and referenced
# Role: platform-engineers — full template and catalog management
# Catalog: read + create entities (from template output)
# Scaffolder: execute templates and read their forms
# DENY: developers cannot register catalog locations (prevents adding rogue templates)
# Omitting catalog.location.create is sufficient — RBAC defaults to deny.
# Assign your IdP groups/users to roles.
